confirm.title: Confirm order
confirm.description: Acknowledge this order and mark it as confirmed.

markProcessing.title: Mark as processing
markProcessing.description: Mark this order as being prepared for shipment.

cancelOrder.title: Cancel order
cancelOrder.description: Cancels this order and releases any reserved stock. Paid orders must be refunded first.

markPaid.title: Mark as paid
markPaid.description: Record the cash-on-delivery or bank-transfer payment as received. Reserved stock becomes a sale and any gift cards or downloads in the order are issued.
